summary: BioMar and Lallemand celebrate 15 years of collaborative innovation in aquaculture. The partnership milestone highlights their joint work in advancing feed and biological solutions for the sector.
title: BioMar y Lallemand celebran 15 años de innovación
title_en: BioMar y Lallemand celebran 15 años de innovación

summary: BioMar announced the winners of its 2024 Farmer of the Year award programme. The announcement recognises exceptional salmon farming operations that have demonstrated outstanding performance and sustainability practices with BioMar feeds and support services. This is a positive program that showcases the company's engagement with its farming customer base and commitment to recognising excellence in the sector.
title: BioMar da a conocer los ganadores del Farmer of the Year 2024
title_en: BioMar da a conocer los ganadores del Farmer of the Year 2024

summary: BioMar is preparing for an ASC (Aquaculture Stewardship Council) audit focused on sustainable production practices. The article reports on the company's readiness and commitment to meeting sustainability certification standards in aquaculture feed production.
title: BioMar se prepara para auditoría ASC en producción sostenible
title_en: BioMar se prepara para auditoría ASC en producción sostenible
